content.text:
NOTICE:  extension "pg_trgm" already exists, skipping
NOTICE:  extension "unaccent" already exists, skipping
CREATE EXTENSION
---
 pg_trgm  | shared_extensions
 plpgsql  | pg_catalog
 unaccent | shared_extensions

observation.command: export PGPASSWORD=root; psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS unaccent;" 2>&1; echo "---"; psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -t -c "select e.extname, n.nspname from pg_extension e join pg_namespace n on n.oid=e.extnamespace order by e.extname;"
